pm.title: Product Manager
pm.experience: 2-4 years of product management experience, ideally at a company building for the first time rather than maintaining what already exists
what_success_looks_like_6_months: Shipped at least two features customers use without being asked to
Can tell Arjun without hesitation what the three most important things to build next are and why
Engineering knows what they're building three sprints out
Has spent time inside freight forwarding operations, not just over calls
what_we_are_looking_for: 2-4 years PM experience, ideally building something for the first time
Comfort operating without structure - no PM handbook, no design system, no sprint template
Evidence of having shipped things, killed things, and learned from both, preferably in short cycles
Genuine curiosity about how operations work at ground level in freight forwarding

spm.title: Senior Product Manager
spm.experience: 5-8 years of product management experience, with clear evidence of owning a product area without a layer of senior PMs above them making the calls
what_success_looks_like_6_months: Owns an integration roadmap that engineering, sales, and Arjun all agree on and trust, unchanged for 6 weeks
At least one major integration shipped that opened a new customer segment or unblocked a stalled deal
Has a clear, defensible point of view on what Kargo should build vs configure vs not touch
Product function has clearer standards for what good PM work looks like
what_we_are_looking_for: 5-8 years PM experience owning a product area without a senior-PM layer above them
Experience with platform products, integration layers, or complex existing technical environments
Proven ability to make calls in ambiguous situations and live with the consequences - no committee approves product decisions at Kargo
Time at an early-stage company, or evidence of operating where the rules were not written yet
Familiarity with operations-heavy industries - logistics, supply chain, or adjacent domains - called out as a genuine advantage, not a nice-to-have
